insight: Grew out of Suna, its open-source generalist agent (19k+ GitHub stars), then rebranded around an enterprise agent platform.
name: Kortix
tagline: Build, deploy, and govern company AI agents as code.
description: Kortix is an open-source platform for building internal AI agents — defining their skills, tools, personas, and guardrails as code, running them in isolated sandboxes that propose work via git branches and pull requests. It ships as the open-source Suna agent plus a managed cloud, with self-host, on-prem, and air-gapped deployment options.

modelSupport.notes: Bring your own LLM provider; works across frontier models.

edge: Treats agents like software — version-controlled, sandboxed, and shippable self-hosted or air-gapped with no vendor lock-in.
pros: Agents commit via git branches and PRs
cons: Self-hosting requires infra and LLM keys
Enterprise agent-as-code model has a learning curve
Managed cloud is seat plus usage priced
